text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a branch of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. One important use is text understanding, which allows machines to read and make sense of written words. NLP also powers translation tools that change text from one language into another. Another common example is sentiment analysis, where computers decide whether a piece of writing is positive, negative, or neutral. Finally, chatbots use NLP to talk with people and answer their questions. Thanks to these technologies, computers can now communicate with us in ways that feel more natural and useful every day.
